scope: Bounded executed replay of 118 target queue against 33 VOXEL-MAN GLBs, 3 unsided OpenEar GLBs and 80 HRA publisher GLBs. Exact name evidence only; no anatomy gap is automatically closed.
labelPolicy: Case and whitespace normalize only. HRA syntactic namespace/side conversion is explicit and does not infer ontology identity; recorded crosswalk labels require an exact actual node. No fuzzy, synonym, component-to-whole or side-to-bilateral match.
notCheckedThisRun: Anatomia Aperta per-component rights and named nerve crosswalk
